desc.en: A type of bird that runs around the desert on two legs. It has an extremely wild disposition, and will never become friendly to humans. When they see something moving, they will always try to race it. It won't harm you as long as you don't stand in front of it.
desc.ja: 砂漠を二本足で走る鳥類の一種。極めて気性が荒く、決して人に懐こうとしない。移動するものを見ると速さ勝負を挑んでくる。目の前に立たなければ、害は少ない
